comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts gripper hardware; this record stops a coasting flywheel with its brake lever before removing and placing a hub nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate counterholds two concentric threaded elements; the record holds a brake against residual motion, then unscrews a nut while respecting a rotating-part exclusion zone.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks locked angle retention; the record checks zero flywheel speed, removed nut in a tray, released lever, clearance, and no premature rim approach.
comparison.reason: Although both include a nut, the record's tested ability is safe residual-energy dissipation before disassembly, not adjustment preservation.
